as per 5 shared experiences, navi interviews are mostly guesstimates + case study (guesstimates in 4 of 5)
• sql in 3 of them, like joins, aggregations and window functions
• probability in 2, like conditional probability
• dsa, dp and system design came up only in the sde intern one

from 1 shared SDE intern experience (IIT Kanpur, on-campus)
• OA had 2 medium-hard DSA questions, one on MST edge weights
• interviews: a DP problem, BFS/DFS graph, then URL shortener design with OS and HLD
• CGPA cutoff was 6.0, 3 rounds in total

apm interview at navi, from 1 shared experience:
• round 1: discussion on your projects (fintech one), 2 sql queries (a join and an aggregate), product design like a feature for swiggy
• round 2: case study on user engagement for a financial product + guesstimate like how many atms in bangalore
• oa on nov 4th had mostly quant, logical and some basic product questions
